answer: Sybil resistance binds each identity to bonded collateral and records signed state transitions, so equivocation yields objective, attributable evidence rather than a mere vote dispute. If k coordinated identities—whether labeled canyon, velvet, and summit or generated at scale—equivocate together, the penalty schedule grows as O(k^2), draining their escrows through pairwise correlation. Detection also applies an exponential capital-loss multiplier, making swarm expansion economically self-defeating despite cheap identity creation.
